lowest_kept_note: Ten kept places have 0 Wikipedia views (Mona Vale Beach, Warriewood Beach, Barrenjoey Lighthouse, WILD LIFE Sydney Zoo, Wattamolla, Burning Palms, Coast Track, Warragamba Dam, Yerranderie and the Landing Place); the Wikipedia article for several is a redirect or absent, so views understate them. Every left-out candidate with views above zero is therefore listed below.

stronger_left_out.name: Penrith
stronger_left_out.reason: Regional city and main base for the Nepean and western Sydney, with its own Wikivoyage chapter; 40k views.

stronger_left_out.name: Sydney Motorsport Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Racing circuit whose public side is paid driving experiences, track days and event meetings run by the operator; no walk-up visit whenever you arrive.

stronger_left_out.name: Hawkesbury River
stronger_left_out.reason: Long river feature with no single access point; its towns (Brooklyn, Windsor, Wisemans Ferry) are the spots.

stronger_left_out.name: Richmond
stronger_left_out.reason: Fails "what qualifies" 2 and 3: an RAAF base and farm town whose only listing is a town overview; no named stop gives a half-hour reason (skeptic reject).

stronger_left_out.name: Royal National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: National park with coastal walks and lagoons; NPWS, Wikivoyage and sydney.com (three sources).

stronger_left_out.name: Nepean River
stronger_left_out.reason: Long river with no single visitor point; Penrith and its riverside parks cover it.

stronger_left_out.name: RAAF Museum
stronger_left_out.reason: Fails 2: sits on an air-force base with entry checks and no counted source (skeptic reject).

stronger_left_out.name: Pittwater
stronger_left_out.reason: Long inlet with no single visitor point; its places (Palm Beach, Church Point) are the spots.

stronger_left_out.name: Blacktown Sportspark
stronger_left_out.reason: Sports fields; not a visitor draw.

stronger_left_out.name: Camden Park Estate
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source; private estate open only on occasional heritage days.

stronger_left_out.name: Sydney Action Park
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source; seasonal water park whose current operation is unconfirmed.

stronger_left_out.name: The Oaks
stronger_left_out.reason: Small village with no distinct draw.

stronger_left_out.name: Lake Burragorang
stronger_left_out.reason: Dam catchment reservoir with restricted public access; no counted source.

stronger_left_out.name: Nattai National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: For: NPWS names the sandstone park for bushwalks. Against: remote and rarely visited; backpack camping, no easy half-hour stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Lake Parramatta
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage names the lake reserve for walks and picnics. Against: one source; local reserve near the CBD.

stronger_left_out.name: Sydney International Regatta Centre
stronger_left_out.reason: Fails 2: a sports venue with little to see outside events, one source (skeptic reject).

stronger_left_out.name: Brislington House
stronger_left_out.reason: Limited opening hours; small specialist museum with one source.

stronger_left_out.name: St Patrick's Cathedral, Parramatta
stronger_left_out.reason: Church seen from the street.

stronger_left_out.name: Wisemans Ferry
stronger_left_out.reason: Hawkesbury village and river crossing, gateway to Dharug and Yengo; Wikivoyage. The ferry is the way across, the village is the place.

stronger_left_out.name: Western Sydney Parklands
stronger_left_out.reason: A park system spread across western Sydney, not one place; its attractions (Sydney Zoo, TreeTops, Chang Lai Yuan) are judged on their own.

stronger_left_out.name: Experiment Farm Cottage
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage lists Australia's first private farm cottage. Against: one source; open Wednesday to Sunday only; small.

stronger_left_out.name: Australiana Pioneer Village
stronger_left_out.reason: Fails 4: open Sundays and bank holiday Mondays only (skeptic reject).

stronger_left_out.name: Big Marley Beach
stronger_left_out.reason: Unpatrolled foot-access beach on the Coast Track; one source.

stronger_left_out.name: Prince Alfred Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Small central park on a gaol site; minor.

stronger_left_out.name: Queens Wharf Reserve
stronger_left_out.reason: Minor riverside reserve with memorials.

stronger_left_out.name: Towra Point Nature Reserve
stronger_left_out.reason: Wetland reserve mostly closed to the public.

stronger_left_out.name: Muogamarra Nature Reserve
stronger_left_out.reason: Open to the public only about six weeks a year on booked tours; not there whenever you arrive.

stronger_left_out.name: Ultimate Paintball
stronger_left_out.reason: Operator (paintball park), not a place.

stronger_left_out.name: Dharug National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: National park north of Wisemans Ferry with the World Heritage Old Great North Road walk; NPWS and Wikivoyage.

stronger_left_out.name: Hambledon Cottage
stronger_left_out.reason: Fails 4: open Thursday to Sunday only and one source (skeptic reject).

stronger_left_out.name: Victoria Bridge, Picton
stronger_left_out.reason: Trestle bridge seen from beside it; minor.

stronger_left_out.name: Powerhouse Parramatta
stronger_left_out.reason: For: new state museum, Wikivoyage lists it, 7 Nov 2026 opening confirmed by NSW Government. Against: not open yet at 18 Oct 2026; re-judge once open.

stronger_left_out.name: Marramarra National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: For: NPWS and Wikivoyage name it. Against: remote and rarely visited, reached mainly by boat or long walks; little for a half-hour stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Campbelltown Arts Centre
stronger_left_out.reason: Fails 3: modest regional gallery, one source; the town spot covers the area (skeptic reject).

stronger_left_out.name: Ku-ring-gai Wildflower Garden
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage lists it; open daily with bush walks. Against: one source, small local garden.

stronger_left_out.name: Joseph Banks Native Plants Reserve
stronger_left_out.reason: Small suburban plant reserve; not a tourist stop.

benchmark.applicable_to_nsw_sydney: The NZ benchmark list does not apply to this region. Equivalent checks: operators rejected as places (Sydney Skydivers, iFLY Penrith, TreeTops, Cables Wake Park, Ultimate Paintball); once-a-week or event-only venues rejected (Australiana Pioneer Village, Muogamarra Nature Reserve); civic/exterior-only buildings rejected (St Patrick's Cathedral Parramatta, Female Orphan School); minor memorials and pull-outs rejected (Queens Wharf Reserve, Bungoona Lookout); a long feature not placed under a neighbour (Hawkesbury River, Nepean River, Royal Coast Track pinned as its own spot with the Royal National Park); gateway-journey case Wisemans Ferry sent to central-coast-hunter; vehicle/operator rule honoured (Wisemans Ferry crossing is not a spot).
